_comment: Purely decorative furniture drawn inside rooms. This is dressing, not simulation: nothing here is clickable, nothing here is reachable, and sim/ never reads this file. That is why props live here and not in ship_layout.json, which is what the simulation treats as truth.
_placement: x and y are fractions of the room rectangle (0..1 from its top-left corner) and size is a fraction of the room's height, so props keep their position and their proportion when the window resizes.
_sprites: Names resolve to assets/props/<name>.png. Every one of those files must have a row in ASSETS.md. tools/validate_data.gd fails if a name has no file or a room id does not exist.
